art_note: Clean studio product shots with accurate details, but lifestyle and size guide images look composited and lack high-end luxury editorial standards.
desc_en: The DAZMOND & Co. small Boston bag combines refined functionality and contemporary design. Crafted from durable PVC with an all-over print, this accessory offers a structured silhouette ideal for daily wear. It features a spacious main compartment and organized interior pockets. Versatility is enhanced by top handles and a detachable, adjustable shoulder strap. An essential piece of timeless design available for worldwide shipping.
desc_es: El bolso Boston pequeño de DAZMOND & Co. combina funcionalidad refinada y diseño contemporáneo. Confeccionado en PVC resistente con un estampado integral, este accesorio ofrece una silueta estructurada ideal para el día a día. Cuenta con un compartimento principal espacioso y bolsillos interiores organizados. Su versatilidad se amplía con asas superiores y una correa de hombro desmontable y ajustable. Una pieza esencial de diseño atemporal disponible para envíos en todo el mundo.
details_en:
· Monogram PVC with all-over print
· Main compartment and two interior pockets
· Removable and adjustable 125 cm shoulder strap
· Water-resistant and lightweight design
· Made-to-order and available for worldwide shipping
details_es:

· Correa de hombro extraíble y ajustable de 125 cm

· Hecho a medida y disponible para envíos en todo el mundo
